experiments.name: reset-chain measurement
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 70364449226751; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 12884901891; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -46909632817835; li.d $r6, 46909632817834' --asm 'xvdiv.h $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.w $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Element-0 reset chain; the closure latency is cancelled by the calibration experiment.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 70364449226751; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 12884901891; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r5, -46909632817835; li.d $r6, 46909632817834' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.w $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Measured over 8 operand pairs; min 16 cycles at 0/1, max 28 cycles at 16383/3. The sample experiment uses the max-latency pair. Latency is derived by subtracting the same closure around vadd.b (calibration experiment).
